implementation.primitive: Render eight adjacent pixels with AVX2/SSE4.1, sharing five chroma columns for four odd/even pairs and two source rows. Preserve centered1/4,3/4phases, clamps, exact /16half-up chroma expansion, saturatedRGB16, Q15studio roundtrip, 15bit truncation and finalQ13byte samples.
implementation.arithmetic: All input chroma values and byte luma, every RGB16cube vertex, every multiply/partial sum/bias and final color interval fit signedInt32. Forward sums reach at most1978454547(Y) and2016937928(U/V), belowInt32.MaxValue. Vector low-word products therefore reproduce the original scalarInt64 values exactly; no float, approximate inverse or tolerance change.
implementation.ownership: Only vector registers/local span views; no new heap/row/frame scratch, persistent state, owner, admission or reservation. Same output allocation/refusal-before-allocation, per-row cancellation, input charge release, failure disposal and borrowed root. Scalar first pixel/tails/narrow rows and unsupported hardware remain actual production fallbacks.

rangeProof.domain: All byte luma and centeredbyte U/V, saturatedRGB16cube vertices, exact integer forward/studio rounding and finalbyte conversion. Partial sums and biases fit signed32; no floating point or approximation.

correctness.denseComparison: Actual new private production vector helper versus actual retained scalar helper, every Y/U/Vbyte combination. Existing native full decoder identities and independent chroma tests also remain exact.
